verdict.rationale: Pulumi treats many resources as one unit of work. Programs use loops and functions to declare resources at scale, and Automation API can create, update, configure and destroy infrastructure programmatically. `pulumi preview --import-file` builds a single import file covering every resource, and policies apply across all managed resources. A community user reports deployments of around 500 resources each. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on bulk operations across many stacks, a bulk workflow evidenced for AI agents (MCP or Neo), and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk import or multi-stack operations.
